The '''fancloth ''ter'angreal''''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' in the possession of the [[White Tower]].

==Appearance==
The appearance of the ''ter'angreal'' is unknown, as it has only ever been mentioned and never shown.

==Use==
The ''ter'angreal'' is used to make the color-shifting material known as [[fancloth]], which is used to make [[Warder]]' cloaks. In the Age of Legends, this was used to make clothing in the highest fashion.
